snippet.title: Mortal Kombat: Legacy Kollection - Gamescom Trailer
snippet.description:
The rarities are konfirmed! Mortal Kombat Mythologies: Sub-Zero and Mortal Kombat: Special Forces join the 20+ games of Mortal Kombat: Legacy Kollection – and for the first time, players can experience the incredibly rare WaveNet arcade version of Ultimate Mortal Kombat 3! Additionally, you can master your finishing moves with the Fatality Trailer, test your might in online and local matches, and dive deep into Mortal Kombat's evolution from passion project to global phenomenon with Digital Eclipse's signature interactive documentary. Prepare yourself – wishlist now for Xbox!
